\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 252-255 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R260-first-pass-words-from-chapters-252-255}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a list and a candidate.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sack, a branch, a bud, a thorn, mud
  \item a rainbow, an earthquake, a flood, a man, a baby
  \item a female friend, a companion, a relative, a mother-in-law, a father-in-law
  \item a daughter-in-law, a son-in-law, a husband's younger brother, a husband's sister, a sister's husband
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sack? (\textbf{\hi{बोरी}}, \emph{borī}.) A branch? (\textbf{\hi{डाली}}, \emph{ḍālī}.) A bud? (\textbf{\hi{कली}}, \emph{kalī}.) A thorn? (\textbf{\hi{काँटा}}, \emph{kā̃ṭā}.) Mud? (\textbf{\hi{कीचड़}}, \emph{kīcaṛ}.) A rainbow? (\textbf{\hi{इंद्रधनुष}}, \emph{indradhanuṣ}.) An earthquake? (\textbf{\hi{भूकंप}}, \emph{bhūkamp}.) A flood? (\textbf{\hi{बाढ़}}, \emph{bāṛh}.) A man? (\textbf{\hi{पुरुष}}, \emph{puruṣ}.) A baby? (\textbf{\hi{शिशु}}, \emph{śiśu}.) A female friend? (\textbf{\hi{सहेली}}, \emph{sahelī}.) A companion? (\textbf{\hi{साथी}}, \emph{sāthī}.) A relative? (\textbf{\hi{संबंधी}}, \emph{sambandhī}.) A mother-in-law? (\textbf{\hi{सास}}, \emph{sās}.) A father-in-law? (\textbf{\hi{ससुर}}, \emph{sasur}.) A daughter-in-law? (\textbf{\hi{बहू}}, \emph{bahū}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{\hi{दामाद}}, \emph{dāmād}.) A husband's younger brother? (\textbf{\hi{देवर}}, \emph{devar}.) A husband's sister? (\textbf{\hi{ननद}}, \emph{nanad}.) A sister's husband? (\textbf{\hi{जीजा}}, \emph{jījā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 256-260 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R260-second-pass-words-from-chapters-256-260}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for vomiting and a wound.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item vomiting, a wound, a bandage, an injection, a pill
  \item the pulse, jealousy, hatred, respect, pride
  \item arrogance, patience, courage, faith, loneliness
  \item restlessness, a crowd, an event, an accident, danger
  \item a convenience, an inconvenience, a rule, a list, a candidate
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Vomiting? (\textbf{\hi{उल्टी}}, \emph{ulṭī}.) A wound? (\textbf{\hi{घाव}}, \emph{ghāv}.) A bandage? (\textbf{\hi{पट्टी}}, \emph{paṭṭī}.) An injection? (\textbf{\hi{टीका}}, \emph{ṭīkā}.) A pill? (\textbf{\hi{गोली}}, \emph{golī}.) The pulse? (\textbf{\hi{नब्ज़}}, \emph{nabz}.) Jealousy? (\textbf{\hi{ईर्ष्या}}, \emph{irṣyā}.) Hatred? (\textbf{\hi{घृणा}}, \emph{ghṛṇā}.) Respect? (\textbf{\hi{सम्मान}}, \emph{sammān}.) Pride? (\textbf{\hi{गर्व}}, \emph{garv}.) Arrogance? (\textbf{\hi{अहंकार}}, \emph{ahaṅkār}.) Patience? (\textbf{\hi{धीरज}}, \emph{dhīraj}.) Courage? (\textbf{\hi{हिम्मत}}, \emph{himmat}.) Faith? (\textbf{\hi{विश्वास}}, \emph{viśvās}.) Loneliness? (\textbf{\hi{अकेलापन}}, \emph{akelāpan}.) Restlessness? (\textbf{\hi{बेचैनी}}, \emph{becainī}.) A crowd? (\textbf{\hi{भीड़}}, \emph{bhīṛ}.) An event? (\textbf{\hi{घटना}}, \emph{ghaṭnā}.) An accident? (\textbf{\hi{दुर्घटना}}, \emph{durghaṭnā}.) Danger? (\textbf{\hi{ख़तरा}}, \emph{khatrā}.) A convenience? (\textbf{\hi{सुविधा}}, \emph{suvidhā}.) An inconvenience? (\textbf{\hi{असुविधा}}, \emph{asuvidhā}.) A rule? (\textbf{\hi{नियम}}, \emph{niyam}.) A list? (\textbf{\hi{सूची}}, \emph{sūcī}.) A candidate? (\textbf{\hi{उम्मीदवार}}, \emph{ummīdvār}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
